1. Extend the channel with the border mode and take its FFT.
2. Compute the log magnitude, and its highest value and median on the ring around every bin, with wrap-around.
3. Mark the bins that stand above the highest value on their ring by the threshold, above the lowest frequency, and widen them.
4. Lower the magnitude at the peaks to the median on the ring and keep the phase.
5. Take the inverse FFT and crop to the image.
